title: Awesome Autumnal Canadian Sweetcorn Hash
description: A lazy Sunday Canadian dish featuring sweetcorn, this hash is perfect for a relaxing autumn morning, with a balance of umami flavors and a satisfying crunch, it is also suitable for a Buddhist temple gathering as it does not contain any animal products.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, maple syrup, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the diced onion, bell pepper, and sliced mushrooms to the bowl and toss to coat with the soy sauce mixture.
Spread the vegetables on a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 20 minutes.
While the vegetables are roasting, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the sweetcorn kernels to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until they are lightly browned and tender.
Once the vegetables are done roasting, add them to the skillet with the sweetcorn and stir to combine.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the hash for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Serve the hash hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Serve on a wooden board for a rustic and cozy presentation.
